technique_name: Compare and contrast the effects of climate change and air pollution
description: Climate change and air pollution both have serious impacts on the environment. Climate change is caused by the release of greenhouse gases and has the potential to cause a wide variety of changes to ecosystems over time, including rising global temperatures, changes in precipitation patterns, and sea level rise.
